meta.title: Cloud cost reduction programme
meta.source: Cloud billing exports, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026; FinOps utilisation scan, Sep 2026

content.text_value: Three levers recover €9.6M of annual cloud spend

slides.title: Savings funnel
slides.takeaway: Only 0.9 of the 9.6 million euros committed has been delivered so far.

content.text_value: Eight steps take the programme from baseline to sustained savings

steps.label: Baseline — Tagged inventory of all resources, reconciled to invoices.
Tag — Mandatory owner, product and environment tags on all spend.
Rightsize — Resize or terminate idle and oversized instances.
Schedule — Shut down dev and test outside working hours.
Commit — Buy committed-use discounts for the steady baseline.
Tier — Lifecycle policies move cold data to archive classes.
Showback — Monthly showback per team, reviewed with directors.
Sustain — Cost checks in the pipeline and architecture reviews.

slides.takeaway: Monthly spend has risen 35 percent in six months and is still accelerating.
